subject: POC: NovaCorp - Trial plan & kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novacorp.com>, Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@novacorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: POC: NovaCorp - Trial plan & kickoff

Hi Sofia & Ethan —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can get the POC scoped and scheduled.

TL;DR: We aligned on a 3-week trial focused on evaluating latency & integration with your query service, with success criteria around 95% API availability, average 95th percentile latency < 250ms for typical prompt sizes, and accuracy measured by your 500-sample test set hitting the baseline F1 target you shared.

Objectives / success criteria
- Functional: Redwood API integrates with NovaCorp dev environment and processes the 500-sample eval set end-to-end.
- Performance: 95th %-ile token latency < 250ms for the specified prompt distributions; throughput to sustain expected concurrent load (30 rps).
- Reliability & observability: Logs, traces, and token-level cost breakdown available to your SREs; automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant on overload.
- Security: Data residency in us-west and access via API tokens/KMS; no customer data persisted beyond KV cache TTL during the trial.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): exchange test data (anonymized), test account setup, baseline eval run. (owners: NovaCorp product/eng)
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests; run first eval set; measure latency and correctness. (owners: Marissa/Vivek + NovaCorp eng)
- Week 2: Stress/throughput testing, iteration on prompt templates, quantization profile suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Final readout: consolidated metrics, runbook, and recommended production config.

Timeline & milestones (proposed)
- Kickoff: week of Oct 19 — propose Tue Oct 20, 10:00am PT (60 min)
- Weekly check-ins: Wed 10:00am PT (30 min) — status/blocks/next actions
- Final readout: Fri Nov 6 — 45 min + delivery of artifacts

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead), Vivek Kulkarni (SE/technical lead)
- NovaCorp: Sofia Ramos (product lead), Ethan Moore (engineering lead)

Immediate next steps
1) I attached a draft POC scope and a mutual action plan (see attachments) — please review and flag any changes.
2) Can you confirm availability for kickoff Tue Oct 20 at 10am PT?
3) Please share a contact for procurement so we can surface SOW/MSA needs early.

Attachments: poc-scope.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: I included the baseline metrics you mentioned on the call; we can adjust the 500-sample test if you want different coverage.

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: NovaCorp - Trial plan & kickoff

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and proposed timeline — this matches our internal expectations and is very helpful.

Quick notes:
- Kickoff looks good — tentative okay for Tue Oct 20, 10am PT. I'll confirm with our engineering calendar today.
- Success criteria match our goals. For "accuracy," can we also track top-1 exact match for the retrieval prompts? We can provide labels for that.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@novacorp.com to start the SOW review. They will want the MSA and expected billing terms; I think a short SOW for the 3-week trial will suffice.
- Data residency: we require logs to remain in-us and need confirmation that telemetry will not include PII. Can you confirm?

Side question for Vivek: will Redwood's SDK need host-level firewall rules, or will we use standard HTTPS calls from our staging environment?

Sofia Ramos
Product Manager, NovaCorp
sofia.ramos@novacorp.com

Thanks Sofia — this is great. Confirming a few items and next steps before kickoff.

1) Kickoff: Confirmed Tue Oct 20, 10:00am PT. I've sent a calendar invite to the list with a short agenda (introductions, environment access, immediate tests, owners & timelines). Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

Agenda (30-45 min)- Introductions & goals (5 min)- Access & test data (10 min)- Baseline eval run plan (10 min)- Timelines / weekly cadence & owners (5-10 min)

2) Data residency & telemetry: Redwood will provision the trial in our us-west region. Telemetry excludes PII by default for trials; we'll provide the SOC2 summary attached and a short note on telemetry fields. Vivek: I flagged the SDK/network question — Vivek, can you confirm minimal network setup?

3) Procurement / SOW: Thanks for CC'ing procurement. For the trial we typically use a one-page SOW + MSA. Marissa (me) will share the MSA and trial SOW template after kickoff; if you want it earlier I can send now.

4) Weekly check-ins: I propose Wednesdays 10:00am PT starting Oct 21 (30 minutes) — we'll use these to triage blockers and review metrics.

5) Pre-kickoff deliverables (owners & ETA)
- NovaCorp: anonymized 500-sample eval set — due Oct 18 (owner: Ethan)
- Redwood: pre-populated eval script and baseline run results — due Oct 19 (owner: Vivek)
- Mutual action plan finalized — due Oct 16 (owner: Marissa/Sofia)

If any timing conflicts, please flag today and we'll adjust. Looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
